title: A French Museum’s “Wanted” Campaign Leads to Stolen Painting’s Return
summary: A 17th-century Dutch painting looted from France during the Second World War has been recovered by the Musée des Beaux-Arts d’Orléans. The painting, Willem Cornelisz Duyster’s Un Buveur (The Drinker), was stolen from Orleans’s Musée Paul Fourché following a Nazi attack on the city in 1940.
